title: Australia Declared War on Birds… and Lost
script: In 1932, Australia sent soldiers with machine guns to fight… birds. Around twenty thousand emus were destroying wheat farms in Western Australia. So the army rolled out with two Lewis guns and ten thousand rounds of ammo. The result? Emus scattered, dodged, and outran the trucks. After nearly ten thousand bullets, the army claimed fewer than a thousand kills. The soldiers were pulled out. The emus stayed. History calls it the Great Emu War, and the emus won.
scenes: 1930s Australian wheat field, dusty, sepia tone
Huge flock of emus running across farmland
Soldiers in 1930s Australian uniforms loading a Lewis machine gun on a truck
Truck bouncing over rough field, emus sprinting away
Single emu standing proudly on a hill at sunset
